As a bonus action, choose a creature you can see within 30 feet and mark it for 1 minute. While it remains marked, you gain the following:

  • Add half your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to any weapon damage roll against the marked target that doesn't already include it.
  • Your critical hit range against the marked target widens by 1.
  • If the marked target drops to 0 hit points, you regain hit points equal to your fighter level plus your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

The mark ends early if you're incapacitated or die. Once used, this feature requires a short or long rest before you can use it again.
